changelog.body:
## Pixel Launcher Folders 0.3.2

- Adds customizable folders to the Pixel Launcher app drawer.
- Sorts folder apps and previews alphabetically.
- Uses clear blue selection ticks, gray other-folder ticks, and empty checkbox outlines.
- Supports user-visible backup and restore.
- Preserves Android profile identity without modifying installed apps.
- Uses the native Home and WM Shell activity-drag paths.

Tested on Pixel 11 Pro Fold, Android 17, Pixel Launcher 17.
Android 15+ and rooted Pixel Launcher devices are required. Other
launcher versions are unverified. Home shortcut, split-screen,
pop-up, and bubble-target dragging remain experimental.

The APK is signed with the permanent release key; its SHA-256 checksum
is included with this release.

readme:
# Pixel Launcher Folders Pixel Launcher Folders is an Xposed/LSPosed module that adds customizable folders to the Pixel Launcher app drawer. ## Features - Create and arrange folders as normal app-drawer cells. - Sort folder contents and four-icon previews alphabetically. - Pick apps with blue ticks for this folder, gray ticks for other folders, and empty outlines for unassigned apps, independent of wallpaper colors. - Optionally keep folder apps out of the main alphabetical app list. - Tap to launch an app; long-press to create a Home shortcut or start a native WM Shell drag. - Back up and restore assignments through Android's user-selected Files storage. - Preserve Android profile identity while excluding Private Space. The module does not edit the launcher database, modify APKs, install apps, or read Private Space. It requires no Internet permission. ## Requirements - Android 15 or newer. - Root access with LSPosed, Vector, or a compatible Xposed framework. - Pixel Launcher package `com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher`. The maintained test target is Pixel 11 Pro Fold, Android 17, Pixel Launcher 17. Other launcher versions are unverified. Home shortcut, split-screen, pop-up, and bubble-target dragging remain experimental; disable the module's launcher scope if an update causes problems. ## Installation 1. Install the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/doccstat/pixel-launcher-folder/releases). 2. Enable Pixel Launcher Folders in LSPosed or Vector. 3. Scope it only to `com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher`. 4. Restart Pixel Launcher and open the Pixel Launcher Folders settings app. ## App icon and name changes Folders refresh when Android reports an app change, including an open folder. **Settings → Follow app icon/name changes** is on by default: the saved launcher entry is preferred, but if it disappears, the app's only current entry in the same profile is used for its icon, name, launch, drag, and folder-only filtering. Following a replacement does not rewrite assignments. Turn this off to require exact entries. If an app has several possible replacement entries, use **Choose apps** to remove the old entry and select the intended one. ## Unavailable apps **Settings → Hide unavailable apps** is on by default. Missing entries are hidden from folder previews and contents, but their assignments are remembered. They reappear when available in the same profile. Turn this off to show placeholders. **Choose apps** always includes missing assignments so you can edit them. **Settings → Remove unavailable assignments…** reviews the exact entries before you confirm removal. It is a one-time cleanup, not automatic deletion. All saved profiles must be unlocked and resumed. Availability and configuration are checked again before saving; a changed result requires another review. ## Backup and restore Choose a folder through Android's document picker. Export writes editable text files plus a JSON manifest containing folder order, IDs, profile identity, and settings, including unavailable-app visibility and saved components for missing apps. Legacy manifests reuse matching local assignments where available. Import accepts that manifest or plain `.txt` files. Import changes only this module's folder configuration; it never installs, removes, disables, or modifies applications. ## Screenshots
## Support Report issues at the [source repository](https://github.com/doccstat/pixel-launcher-folder/issues) with the device model, Android version, Pixel Launcher version, module version, and reproduction steps. **Settings → Export diagnostics** saves a JSON report through Files with versions, display options, per-profile availability counts, and recent settings/cleanup results. It omits folder names, app assignments, storage paths and device identifiers; nothing is uploaded. The source UI language is English, used as the fallback for all device languages. New settings use Android string resources; counts follow the device locale and layout follows its text direction. ## Disclaimer Pixel Launcher Folders modifies Pixel Launcher through an Xposed/LSPosed module. It requires root and is intended for personal use on devices you own. It is not affiliated with Google, Pixel Launcher, LSPosed, or any device manufacturer. Use it at your own risk and back up your launcher configuration: an incompatible launcher or firmware update can hide or break the module, and a root/Xposed failure can prevent the device from booting. The authors are not responsible for data loss, warranty issues, or problems caused by other modules or firmware. ## License Pixel Launcher Folders is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3 only (`GPL-3.0-only`). See the [license text](https://github.com/doccstat/pixel-launcher-folder/blob/main/LICENSE). This program is distributed in the hope that it will be useful, but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
readmeZh: # 像素启动器文件夹 Pixel Launcher 文件夹是一个 Xposed/LSPosed 模块，添加了可自定义的 文件夹到 Pixel Launcher 应用程序抽屉。 ## 特点 - 像普通的应用程序抽屉单元一样创建和排列文件夹。 - 按字母顺序对文件夹内容和四个图标预览进行排序。 - 为该文件夹选择带有蓝色勾号的应用程序，为其他文件夹选择带有灰色勾号的应用程序，以及 未分配的应用程序的空轮廓，与壁纸颜色无关。 - 可以选择将文件夹应用程序保留在按字母顺序排列的主应用程序列表之外。 - 点击启动应用程序；长按可创建 Home 快捷方式或启动本机 WM Shell 拖动。 - 通过 Android 用户选择的文件存储备份和恢复分配。 - 保留 Android 配置文件身份，同时排除私人空间。 该模块不会编辑启动器数据库、修改 APK、安装应用程序或 阅读私人空间。它不需要互联网许可。 ## 要求 - Android 15 或更高版本。 - 使用 LSPod、Vector 或兼容的 Xposed 框架进行根访问。 - Pixel Launcher 包“com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher”。 维护的测试目标是Pixel 11 Pro Fold、Android 17、Pixel Launcher 17。 其他启动器版本未经验证。 Home快捷方式、分屏、弹窗、 气泡目标拖动仍处于实验阶段；禁用模块的启动器 如果更新导致问题的范围。 ## 安装 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/doccstat/pixel-launcher-folder/releases) 安装 APK。 2. 在 LSPod 或 Vector 中启用 Pixel Launcher 文件夹。 3. 仅将其范围限定为“com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher”。 4. 重新启动 Pixel Launcher 并打开 Pixel Launcher 文件夹设置应用程序。 ## 应用程序图标和名称更改 当 Android 报告应用程序更改时，文件夹会刷新，包括打开的文件夹。 **设置 → 关注应用程序图标/名称更改** 默认情况下处于启用状态：保存的启动器 条目是首选，但如果它消失，则应用程序在 相同的配置文件用于其图标、名称、启动、拖动和仅文件夹过滤。 替换后不会重写分配。关闭此功能以要求 准确的条目。如果应用程序有多个可能的替换条目，请使用 **选择应用程序**以删除旧条目并选择所需的条目。 ## 不可用的应用程序 **设置→隐藏不可用的应用程序**默认处于启用状态。缺失的条目被隐藏 来自文件夹预览和内容，但会记住它们的分配。他们 当在同一配置文件中可用时重新出现。关闭此选项以显示占位符。 **选择应用程序**始终包含缺失的作业，以便您可以编辑它们。 **设置→删除不可用的作业...**查看之前的确切条目 您确认删除。这是一次性清理，不是自动删除。全部保存 必须解锁并恢复配置文件。检查可用性和配置 保存之前再一次；更改的结果需要再次审核。 ## 备份与恢复 通过 Android 的文档选择器选择一个文件夹。导出写入可编辑文本 文件加上一个 JSON 清单，其中包含文件夹顺序、ID、配置文件身份和 设置，包括不可用的应用程序可见性和已保存的丢失组件 应用程序。旧清单重用匹配的本地分配（如果可用）。进口 接受清单或纯“.txt”文件。导入更改 仅此模块的文件夹配置；它永远不会安装、删除、禁用、 或修改应用程序。 ## 截图 <表> ## 支持 在[源存储库](https://github.com/doccstat/pixel-launcher-文件夹/问题） 包含设备型号、Android 版本、Pixel Launcher 版本、模块版本、 和再现步骤。 **设置 → 导出诊断** 保存 JSON 报告 通过包含版本、显示选项、每个配置文件可用性计数的文件， 以及最近的设置/清理结果。它省略了文件夹名称、应用程序分配、 存储路径和设备标识符；没有上传任何内容。 源 UI 语言为英语，用作所有设备语言的后备语言。 新设置使用Android字符串资源；计数遵循设备区域设置，并且 布局遵循其文本方向。 ## 免责声明 Pixel Launcher文件夹通过Xposed / LPosed模块修改Pixel Launcher。 它需要 root 权限，仅供个人在您拥有的设备上使用。它不是 与 Google、Pixel Launcher、LSPoded 或任何设备制造商有关联。使用 风险由您自行承担，并备份您的启动器配置：不兼容 启动器或固件更新可以隐藏或破坏模块，并且 root/Xposed 故障可能会导致设备无法启动。作者不承担任何责任 数据丢失、保修问题或其他模块或固件引起的问题。 ## 许可证 Pixel Launcher 文件夹已获得 GNU 通用公共许可证版本的许可 仅 3（“仅 GPL-3.0”）。请参阅 [许可证文本](https://github.com/doccstat/pixel-launcher-folder/blob/main/LICENSE)。 分发此程序的目的是希望它有用，但没有任何帮助 保修；甚至没有适销性或适用性的默示保证 特定目的。
